page: Microsoft Azure E64-32ads_v5 is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 7763 processor running at 3.525 GHz. It features 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs via Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. The hardware configuration includes 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 16.0 GB per vCPU. Storage is bundled with a 2458 GB local SSD, and the instance supports Premium Storage. No GPU accelerators are present.

Benchmark results show strong single-core CPU performance in stress-ng tests and strong image processing capabilities in Geekbench. Passmark memory testing also ranks in the top 25%. However, multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations fall into the average tier. Large-scale LLM inference is a notable bottleneck, with prompt processing for a 70B model scoring in the bottom 25%.

Given the high memory density of 16 GB per vCPU and the inclusion of a 2458 GB local SSD, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require massive parallel GPU acceleration. It is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, memory-heavy data processing, enterprise applications, and caching layers like Redis, where its average multi-core and strong memory performance profiles align with operational demands.
